# Stake INJ with FP Validated

Injective uses delegated proof-of-stake built on the Cosmos SDK. You delegate INJ from your own address to a validator, and your tokens never leave your control.

## Before you start

- A wallet supported by Injective Hub. The Hub lists the options when you select Connect Wallet.
- Enough INJ to stake, plus a little extra for gas.

## Stake with Injective Hub

1. Open [Injective Hub](https://injhub.com/stake) and connect your wallet.
2. Search the validator list for **FP Validated**.
3. Confirm the validator operator address matches the key facts table. Do not rely on the name alone.
4. Enter the amount of INJ and choose **Stake** (or **Delegate**).
5. Review and sign the transaction in your wallet.

Rewards start accruing from the next block.

## Rewards

- Rewards accrue every block but are **not** compounded automatically. Claim them from Injective Hub and stake them again if you want them to compound.
- Commission is taken from rewards, not principal.

## Unstake

1. In Injective Hub, open your delegation to FP Validated and choose **Unstake** (or **Undelegate**).
2. Sign the transaction.
3. Your INJ is returned to your address automatically when the 21-day unbonding period ends. It earns no rewards during unbonding.

You can have at most 7 unbonding requests to the same validator at once. To move stake to another validator without waiting, use **Redelegate** if Injective Hub offers it.

## Fees

- **Validator commission:** shown in the key facts table. Check the explorer for the live rate.
- **Gas:** each staking, claiming and unstaking transaction pays a small gas fee in INJ.

## Risks

- **Jailing.** On-chain slashing for double signing and downtime is currently set to 0%, so your principal is not reduced. A validator that signs fewer than 50% of recent blocks is jailed, and its delegators earn no rewards while it is jailed. Slashing parameters can change through governance.
- **Unbonding period.** Unstaked tokens are locked for 21 days and cannot be transferred during that time.
- **Signing risk.** Always check the validator address before signing.

See [Responsiveness and Slashing Policy](/fp-validated-infra/responsiveness-and-slashing-policy) for how FP Validated responds to incidents.

## Institutional staking

Institutions can stake INJ from custody platforms that support Injective delegation. Contact FP Validated to confirm that our validator is available on your custodian.

## FAQ

**Do I need to claim rewards?**
Yes. Rewards build up until you claim them. Claiming and re-staking is how you compound.

**When do I get my tokens back after unstaking?**
After 21 days. They return to your address automatically.

**Can I switch validators without waiting 21 days?**
Yes, with a redelegation, if your wallet or app supports it.
